summary: MARILÓ Café fullstack testing: 15/15 backend pytest cases passed (auth, menu/products/gallery/recipes CRUD, settings). Frontend homepage renders all sections with correct data-testids; admin login/logout/dashboard fully functional with menu CRUD verified end-to-end. One critical routing bug found in admin NavLink relative paths.

ui_bugs.issue: NavLink uses relative `to` props (e.g. to='galeria'), so clicking from /admin/menu produces /admin/menu/galeria → /admin/menu/galeria/ajustes (path concatenation), navigating to non-existent routes that render blank content. Should use absolute paths like to='/admin/galeria' or restructure routes.

issues: Individual menu items do not have data-testid attributes (e.g. menu-item-{id}); only the section container has menu-section testid. Considered minor since content renders correctly.

action_items: Fix AdminDashboard sidebar NavLinks: use absolute paths (e.g. to='/admin/menu', to='/admin/galeria') so cross-section navigation works without URL path concatenation.
(Optional) Add data-testid to individual menu/product/gallery cards on the public homepage for better future testability.

Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_marilo_api.py -v. Admin dashboard sidebar uses react-router NavLink with relative `to` paths (in /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx line 14-17). After E1 fixes to absolute paths, re-test admin cross-tab navigation. Public homepage has all required testids: nav-home/menu/shop/recipes/gallery/location, hero-cta-menu, menu-section, tiendita-section, recipe-shelf-section, gallery-section, location-map, footer-contact, instagram-follow-btn - all confirmed present.
rca of the issue: AdminDashboard sidebar nav uses NAV array with `to: 'menu'`, `to: 'galeria'` etc passed to react-router NavLink. NavLink resolves relative paths against current location, so from /admin/menu, to='galeria' resolves to /admin/menu/galeria (not /admin/galeria). Routes are likely defined as children of /admin in App.jsx but relative navigation across siblings requires either absolute path (to='/admin/galeria') or `to='../galeria'`. Fix: change NAV entries to absolute paths or use end={true} with start-relative paths.
